Summarize a burn without materializing it

Source: R/cb_summary.R
summary.cb_burn.Rd

Compute a compact description of a cb_burn() object in time proportional to the number of records in its tables, never to the number of grid cells. The pieces are:

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cb_burn'
summary(object, tiles = 256L, ...)

Arguments

object

A cb_burn object.

tiles

Target number of tiles along the longer grid axis for the overview. The tile size in cells is ceiling(max(dimension) / tiles).

...

Ignored.

Value

A list of class summary.cb_burn.

Details

overview

a coarse raster of mean coverage per tile, in the same read_ds layout as cb_materialize() (see cb_overview()). When the grid is small enough that one tile is one cell, this is the exact coverage.

row_marginal, col_marginal

exact covered-cell totals per grid row and per grid column, at full resolution.

content

the extent and 1-based row/col range of touched cells, or NULL for an empty burn. cb_crop() uses this as its default window.

area

per-geometry totals: interior (run cells), boundary (summed edge fractions), lines (summed length), points (count).

fractions

quantiles of the edge coverage fractions.

records

row counts of the five tables.

Coverage here means: run cells 1 each, edge cells their fraction, line and point cells 1 each (presence).
